description:
# Future Directions — Consciousness as Integrated Information

This cycle established a fully verified core for Integrated Information Theory
(IIT) in `Catalog/Novelty/IntegratedInformation.lean`:

- `mutualInfo` of a joint `FinDist (α × β)` (KL to the product of marginals),
  with `mutualInfo_nonneg` (Gibbs), `mutualInfo_eq_zero_iff` (vanishes iff
  independent), and `mutualInfo_swap` (symmetry of a part vs. its complement).
- The Minimum-Information-Partition value `Phi` over a nonempty family of cuts
  `Finset (Finset ι)`, with `Phi_nonneg` and `Phi_eq_zero_iff` (Φ vanishes iff
  some candidate cut decomposes the system into independent parts).
- Witnesses: `mutualInfo_prod = 0` (product = unintegrated) and
  `mutualInfo_correlatedBits_pos` (a maximally correlated pair of bits has Φ > 0).

The following conjectures are precise, falsifiable, and ready to formalize.

## C1 — Capacity upper bound on integration
For any `P : FinDist (α × β)`,
`mutualInfo P ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card α)` and symmetrically
`mutualInfo P ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card β)`; hence
`mutualInfo P ≤ Real.log (min (Fintype.card α) (Fintype.card β))`.
*Test:* equality is approached by the correlated-bits family generalized to
`n`-ary perfectly-correlated states, where `mutualInfo = Real.log n`.

## C2 — Chain rule / superadditivity for a refined cut
For a tripartite `P : FinDist (α × (β × γ))` with the induced bipartite views,
`mutualInfo (X ; (Y,Z)) = mutualInfo (X ; Y) + condMutualInfo (X ; Z | Y)`,
where the conditional term is `≥ 0`. Consequently coarsening a cut (merging two
sides) cannot decrease the cross-cut mutual information.
*Test:* with all three parts independent both sides are `0`; with `Z = X` the
conditional term carries the full `mutualInfo (X;X)`.

## C3 — Data-processing monotonicity of Φ
If `K` is a stochastic channel applied independently within each side of a cut
(a per-part `Markov` map), then `mutualInfo (pushforward K P) ≤ mutualInfo P`,
and therefore `Phi` cannot increase under intra-part processing. Formally: a
column-stochastic matrix acting on one factor is a contraction for `mutualInfo`.
*Test:* the identity channel gives equality; a constant (information-erasing)
channel sends `mutualInfo` to `0`.

## C4 — Φ = 0 ⇔ global Markov factorization
For the full MIP family `cuts = univ \ {∅, univ}` over `ι`,
`Phi P cuts hne = 0` iff `P` factorizes as a product across *some* nontrivial
bipartition of the elements `ι`. Strengthen to: a system is "minimally
integrated" exactly when its dependency hypergraph is disconnected.
*Test:* a product distribution over two element-blocks has `Phi = 0`; the
all-bits-equal distribution over `n ≥ 2` elements has `Phi > 0` for every cut.

## C5 — Continuity / stability of integration
`mutualInfo` is uniformly continuous in `P` on the simplex away from the
boundary, and globally bounded; quantitatively, for distributions within total
variation `δ`, `|mutualInfo P − mutualInfo Q|` is controlled by a modulus
`ω(δ)` independent of `P, Q` (a Csiszár–Kemperman–Kullback-style bound).
*Test:* perturbing the correlated-bits masses by `ε` changes `mutualInfo`
continuously, with no jump at independence.
title: Fully verified core for Integrated Information Theory
